messages:
Maya (support): FYI customer on Android Pixel 6 reports the dashboard chart legend labels no longer match the color swatches in compact mode. Tooltips also show the wrong metric name when tapping a point. Screenshot: https://rwd-inf-support.s3.amazonaws.com/1805004321/pixel6-legend-mismatch.png

Devon (mobile-eng): Can you paste quick repro steps + app build? I've seen similar on older WebView embeds.

Maya (support): Steps from the customer: 1) Open Console > Analytics 2) Select 'Daily traffic' chart 3) Switch to Compact layout (top-right) 4) Tap legend items to isolate series -> labels look shifted, tapping label highlights a different color. App build 2026.02.14 (play store). Happens on portrait only.

Sam (frontend): Do they see the same on iOS / desktop? Asking to narrow to mobile CSS vs data bug.

Maya (support): Customer says desktop and iOS are fine. Only Android compact portrait. They also noticed that when they rotate to landscape it fixes itself.

Ingrid (analytics): Quick check: could be a rendering reorder after series list is streamed vs static color map. Maya can you run the analytics API for that org and chart id and paste the series order? curl example:

```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://api.redwood-inference/v1/orgs/1234/charts/5678/series"
```

Response should show series ids + color assignments. If series array order != legend DOM order we get mismatch.

Maya (support): Ran query, series array shows ["s3","s1","s2"] with colors ["#3b82f6","#ef4444","#f59e0b"]. In-app legend order displayed: s1, s2, s3 (colors still in array order). So label order and color array seem out of sync.

Devon (mobile-eng): Reproduced locally on Pixel emulator with compact=true. Root cause: compact mode applies CSS transform to compress items and then we use absolute-positioned color swatches tied to original index, not DOM order. When items wrap the visual order changes but swatch placement stays bound to index. Quick repro patch: change legend render to attach swatch to each label node instead of separate absolute layer. Minimal CSS snippet causing issue:

```
.legend--compact { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; transform: translateZ(0); }
.legend--swatches { position: absolute; right: 12px; }
```

This makes swatches independent from labels when wrap happens.

Sam (frontend): That matches what I expected. Fix: remove absolute layer and render swatch inline with label, maintain accessibility attributes. I'll open PR with tests.

Maya (support): Customer patch preference? They asked for a temporary workaround they can do.

Devon (mobile-eng): Workaround: In app settings toggle "Compact layout" off or rotate device to landscape. Also we can force a reflow by toggling chart zoom (pinch in/out) which rebinds positions. Not ideal but works.

Sam (frontend): Opening PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/4821 - changes legend render, includes unit + e2e for compact wrap. ETA for review: today.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled for channel=console-canary at 2026-03-18T15:30:00Z for PR 4821.

Devon (mobile-eng): I'll validate on Pixel farm once canary is up, then roll to stable if green. Filing internal ticket ENG-2931 to track customer escalation.

Maya (support): Noted, I've informed customer about workaround and ETA. Marking this P2->P1 due to user impact on Android dashboard. :thumbsup:

Sam (frontend): Patch merged to canary, follow-up will include release notes about compact legend fix.

Maya (support): Thank you everyone — will update thread when customer confirms the fix on their end.
